words.example_ar: بِٱلْعَدْلِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ نِعِمَّا يَعِظُكُم بِهِۦٓ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًۭا
words.example_en: judge with justice. Excellent is that which Allāh instructs you. Indeed, Allāh is ever Hearing and Seeing.
words.short_example_ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًۭا
words.short_example_en: Indeed Allah is All-Hearing All-Seeing
words.gpt_example_en: Indeed, He is of His slaves All-Aware All-Seer

words.example_ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَقُولُوا۟ رَٰعِنَا وَقُولُوا۟ ٱنظُرْنَا وَٱسْمَعُوا۟ ۗ وَلِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
words.example_en: O you who have believed, say not to Allāh's Messenger, "Rāʿinā" but say, "Unẓurnā" and listen. And for the disbelievers is a painful punishment.
words.short_example_ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَقُولُوا۟
words.short_example_en: O you who believed Do not say
words.gpt_example_en: your religion and (do) not say about Allah
words.pass2_gpt_example: لَا تَقُولُوا عَلَى اللَّهِ إِلَّا الْحَقَّ

words.example_ar: قَدْ خَلَتْ ۖ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَلَكُم مَّا كَسَبْتُمْ ۖ وَلَا تُسْـَٔلُونَ عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
words.example_en: That was a nation which has passed on. It will have the consequence of what it earned, and you will have what you have earned. And you will not be asked about what they used to do.
words.short_example_ar: تِلْكَ أُمَّةٌۭ قَدْ خَلَتْ ۖ
words.short_example_en: This was a community which has passed away
words.gpt_example_en: Verily passed from before you situations

words.example_ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بِنَآءًۭ وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَخْرَجَ بِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ رِزْقًۭا لَّكُمْ ۖ
words.example_en: He who made for you the earth a bed spread out and the sky a ceiling and sent down from the sky, rain and brought forth thereby fruits as provision for you. So do not attribute to Allāh equals while you know that there is nothing similar to Him.
words.short_example_ar: ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ رِزْقًۭا لَّكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟
words.short_example_en: Fruits as provision for you
words.gpt_example_en: and the sea and We have provided them of the good things and We preferred them
